notes: The mutants replace the served fields with a generic icon and the system blue: the seam then reads a value different from the fixture account's icon_id and colour (expected values come from fixtures: account-mark.py:30-37 expected()). Proof 0 is the judge's own mutant table (no app): '| list-provider | ... | RED: icon@list-row: ... |'. Its live part reads NOT JUDGED without a socket, so exit is 1: judge by the lines. gap-engine-state (outside): what only a device can end is the iPhone row surface (needs the iPhone simulator rig and WHOOSH_IPHONE_SOCKET_DIR: this Mac lacks the iOS 26.5 runtime, account-mark.py:56-60 reads NOT JUDGED) and, on the real core, the notch (an arrival; the real-core slice delivers none, so `icon@notch` and `colour@notch` print NOT JUDGED in `--slice-accountmark`). Everything else is built: the fixture seam's own run (proofs 0 and 1, the lead's first run, red then green by its mutant table) and the real-core cell `checks/realcore-check.py --slice-accountmark` (drive_accountmark, judge_accountmark, main_slice_accountmark) with the engine test core/crates/engine/tests/engine_account_mark.rs (the accounts the surfaces draw from). For the owner of checks/seams/**: the docstring of checks/seams/account-mark.py lines 3-6 still says the sidebar ring, reader header and search result serve no icon field yet; they do now (SidebarFeature.swift:42, ReaderHeaderProbe.swift:15, SearchMacRows.swift:83): update it, nothing else is needed for the run. real-accounts (2026-11-12): the real core now serves SetAccountIcon (library glyph or upload), SetAccountColour and the state paths account_icon/<id> and account/<id>/colour (core/crates/engine/src/account_cmds.rs, store functions in core/crates/store/src/realcore.rs); proof 5 is core/crates/engine/tests/engine_account_cmds.rs (icon_library_and_upload_read_back_and_the_limits_refuse, colour_is_checked_stored_upper_case_and_survives_a_restart, a_new_account_has_the_first_free_palette_colour_and_no_invented_icon). A hidden real-engine case can now pick an icon through the door mac-settings-accounts.icon-library.<glyph> (after mac-settings-accounts.<id>.icon) and read account_icon/<id> and the list row's account_icon.
